_readme: MegaETH (4326) seed pools. Run: SEED_POOLS=config/megaeth.json ./scripts/seed.sh megaeth [--broadcast]. WETH kind = the chain's wrapped-native (weth9 0x4200..0006, from contracts/deployments/megaeth.json); the seeder auto-wraps native ETH if the WETH balance is short. tHOOK/tUSDC are fresh MINT test tokens (no stablecoin needed). priceAperB values are DEMO ratios (tUSDC is a test token, not a real quote). Amounts are DEMO-scale — size to the funded deployer balance before --broadcast (see robinhood.json for a ~$1 dust proof). The v2 pool is cheap; the v3 mint is more gas-hungry, so seed v2 first on a thin balance.
